method: Enumerate all 528 unordered pairs of the 33 original frame/cog parts. Temporarily remove all components of both parts, keep the other 62 poses fixed, and construct every inclusive integer free-anchor cell for both restored originals and both extra brackets. Sweep each component over every cell to obtain outward occupied covers. Test exact continuous union areas for all seven nonempty role subsets on each sheet, for every allowed sheet/count allocation, plus full original-area capacity. All parts mandatory. Existing finite source orientation inventory, material bounds and floor-safe inner proxies retained. Positive clearance is dropped only in this necessary diagnostic. Preserve incomplete cases and all pending work if time/cell bounds are reached. No solver call, full target witness, acceptance or unrestricted infeasibility claim.
